messages:
Alex: Heads up — escalation from Acme Support. Their per-model throughput panels went to 0 around 2026-03-15 21:30 UTC. Customers seeing high p99 and perceived cold starts. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.com/esc/abc123.png
Sam: Do you have the dashboard/panel and the exact query?
Alex: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/throughput?orgId=1 panelId=7. Query they were using (copied from panel):
Alex: sum(rate(redwood_inference_tokens_total{model=~".*"}[1m])) by (model)
Jesse: We shipped an exporter change in infra PR #412 that normalized labels and renamed "model" -> "model_id" to match catalog fields. That went out ~2026-03-15T21:25Z. Could explain it.
Priya: Confirming Jesse's note — exporter relabeled the metric keys at scrape time. Grafana panels haven't been updated so they don't match any series now.
GrafanaBot: alert: dashboard "Per-model throughput" panels returned no series for >10m (rule: grafana_panel_no_series).
Sam: Quick workaround for Support: change panel to use model_id or use label_replace until dashboards are updated. Example PromQL snippets:
Sam: ```promql
# use the new label directly
sum(rate(redwood_inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (model_id)

# temporary label shim to expose old label name in-panel
label_replace(sum(rate(redwood_inference_tokens_total[1m])), "model", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")
```
Alex: Can we get a short-lived fix from infra so we don't have to ask every customer to change their panels? Support needs a deployable mitigation to tell the customer timeline.
Priya: I'll push a compatibility shim in the exporter to keep the "model" label in addition to "model_id" for 24h. I'll also open a dashboard task to update all panels to model_id. ETA ~30m for deploy to staging, 45m to prod.
Jesse: Opening PR 418 to add duplicated label and a flag to flip off later. Assigning to Priya for deploy.
GrafanaBot: deploy started by Jesse — 2026-03-15T21:45:00Z (staging)
Priya: Deployed compatibility shim to staging and then prod at 2026-03-15T21:53:12Z. Exporter now emits both model and model_id.
Sam: I can confirm via Prometheus query that series are back: sum by(model)(rate(redwood_inference_tokens_total[1m])) returns multiple series.
Alex: Notifying Acme Support and updating their ticket with the workaround + timeline.
Jesse: We'll follow up with a dashboard migration plan and a config doc for external customers who manage their own Grafana.
Priya: Created dashboard update ticket #SUP-872 and flagged for next 24h sweep. Also added an annotation on Grafana at 2026-03-15T21:54:00Z noting exporter label rename and quick mitigation.
Alex: Thanks — closing this escalation once customer confirms graphs look normal. :thumbsup:
Sam: Customer confirmed restored graphs at 21:58 UTC. Closing thread.
